description: This file defines the PresignUrlMiddleware class used for generating presigned URLs for AWS service operations, including methods for constructing, wrapping, and creating presigned URLs with specific endpoint handling.

classes.name: PresignUrlMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for generating presigned URLs for AWS service commands, handling endpoint resolution, URL signing, and command wrapping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing middleware with options, endpoint provider, AWS client, and next handler.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a middleware wrapper function for AWS clients.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes middleware to add presigned URL to commands if required.

methods.name: createPresignedUrl
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for a given AWS command, handling endpoint resolution and request signing.
